info.cls_ename: SJSU-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: This course is a continuation of Electrical and Computer Engineering Fundamentals I. The content includes operational amplifiers, small signal amplification of transistors at mid frequencies, calculating the low cut-off frequency and the high cut-off frequency to find mid-band bandwidth. In addition, Laplace transform and Fourier transform techniques, the frequency response of linear circuits, passive filters, and active filters are introduced. The course ends with an introduction to how circuits can be modeled for analysis at high frequencies.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
No meal is allowed in class.
Students are responsible for attending all the class schedules and completing all the assigned class assignments and programming projects by the scheduled due date.
上課時不允許於教室內用餐。
學生有責任遵守所有課程安排，並在預定截止日期前完成所有指定的課程作業和程式設計專案。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Students must meet all the course requirements independently and will not give or receive unauthorized help.
Students must complete all the Tests on their own and will not give or receive any unauthorized help.
Any cheating behavior will result in an F for the class.
